name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian's passion for motorsport ignited during her university days, fuelled by countless hours spent building and racing virtual cars in online simulations. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the National University of Singapore, she sought to bridge the gap between the virtual and real worlds of racing. She began her career at a local sim racing center, refining her skills in data analysis and simulator setup before joining Reiza Racing Academy.

As a simulator engineer, Mei Lian excels at translating driver feedback into tangible improvements in the virtual environment. Her meticulous approach to data collection and analysis, combined with her natural talent for problem-solving, allows her to fine-tune the simulator to perfectly replicate real-world conditions. She is known for her ability to quickly identify and resolve technical issues, ensuring that drivers get the most out of their simulator sessions. Mei Lian's dedication to her craft and her unwavering pursuit of perfection make her a valuable asset to the team.

Mei Lian's ambition extends beyond the simulator bay. She is determined to contribute to the success of Reiza Racing Academy by helping drivers to develop their skills and ultimately achieve their goals on the track. She sees the simulator as a crucial tool in modern motorsport, and she is committed to pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
